avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces indinavir levels by 50-75%, significantly reducing antiretroviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Counsel patient on alternative mood support options

avoid_supplements.name: Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer dramatically decreases indinavir plasma concentrations below therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; coordinate with prescriber if TB prophylaxis needed

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce indinavir bioavailability; fresh garlic generally safe
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concentrated garlic supplements; culinary amounts of fresh garlic acceptable

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 modulation; limited clinical data with protease inhibitors
caution_supplements.action: Monitor virologic response; use only under clinical supervision if benefits outweigh risks

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition; effect generally minimal with indinavir
caution_supplements.action: Occasional use acceptable; maintain consistent intake patterns

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases indinavir concentrations, elevating toxicity risk and nephrolithiasis potential
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; educate on all grapefruit products including pomelo and Seville oranges

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significantly reduces indinavir absorption; take on empty stomach for optimal bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Administer indinavir 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals; light snack acceptable if needed

caution_foods.name: Cranberry juice
caution_foods.mechanism: May acidify urine; modest risk of crystal nephropathy when combined with indinavir
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; maintain adequate hydration (1.5L+ daily) to prevent kidney stone formation

caution_foods.name: Caffeinated beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild CYP1A2 interaction; no major impact on indinavir but may increase adverse effects
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; monitor for increased nausea or GI upset

monitoring_notes: Indinavir carries significant nephrolithiasis risk; counsel patients on adequate hydration (>48 oz water daily) and monitor renal function periodically. Maintain consistent dietary patterns and ensure strict adherence to fasting requirements to optimize antiretroviral efficacy and minimize toxicity.
